Maya: Heads-up: Acme dedicated go-live scheduled Thu 07:00 PT. Final check on quota windows, headroom, and the 'billguard' threshold before we flip.
Priya: On billing: Acme agreed to a 25% short-term headroom for 72h, but wants automatic notifications if projected burst spend > $2k/day. I'll draft the alert runbook.
Jorge: Loadtest idea: three stages - smoke (10m), progressive ramp (45m to peak), and a 90m soak at ~75% of peak token throughput. Will share k6 script and expected RPS/time series.
Liam: Autoscale suggestion: policy tuned for seq-heavy workloads. Params below. I can push to infra repo once approved.
Liam: ```json
{
  "metric":"combined_latency_cpu",
  "min":3,
  "max":30,
  "scale_up_pct":0.6,
  "scale_down_pct":0.25,
  "evaluation_interval_s":20,
  "cooldown_s":90
}
```
Maya: Thanks. Can we ensure warmup tasks run so KV cache hit rate >= 65% before soak? That affects token cost a lot.
Jorge: Good call. I'll add a warmup phase that replays top-10 prompts for 15m to prime KV.
Priya: I'll attach billing alert YAML: send to ops + AE, and page if spend estimate crosses 50% of burst allowance. Also logging requirement: tag all burst usage with "burst_acme" for chargeback.
Sam: Renewal note: flag as at-risk if two-week avg consumption > 80% of reserved for any 7-day window. AE to engage if flagged.
Maya: Routing fallback: plan to bleed 3% of traffic to hosted fallback when 95th latency > 700ms for 2m. Is that feasible?
Liam: Yup. We'll configure a canary route with circuit-breaker. Example rule: `cb{latency_ms:700,window_s:120,bleed_pct:3,fallback:hosted}`
Jorge: For loadtests use these commands: `k6 run --vus 150 --duration 45m loadtests/acme_ramp.js` then `k6 run --vus 600 --duration 90m loadtests/acme_soak.js` (after warmup).
Maya: Ops checklist: 1) Confirm alert thresholds in PagerDuty (Priya). 2) Push autoscale policy (Liam). 3) Jorge: share k6 + warmup snippet. 4) Sam: add renewal gating rule to CRM. Reconvene Wed 09:30 PT.
